headings.usage: Utilitarian, sharp, clear. Tracking-tight for large headings.

body.usage: Highly legible, tabular numbers for pallet counts, order IDs, and PINs.

accent.description: Klein Blue for primary actions (Save, Submit, Camera Trigger)

destructive.description: Signal Red for disputes, deletions, alerts.

background.description: Pure white for app background, 5% grey for subtle container distinctions.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders & Tactical Minimalism. Use 1px solid strokes instead of soft shadows. Replace soft shadows with 2px inner glow highlights or crisp 1px borders.
visual_enhancers.borders: rounded-sm (4px) or completely sharp edges. No large border radii.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (Duotone or Bold weight) for high legibility in warehouse environments. Install via: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react

grids_and_layouts.mobile: Mobile-first approach. Large tap areas (min-h-[48px] or 3rem) for all interactive elements to support usage with gloves. Use standard Flexbox and Grid with `gap-4` or `gap-6`.
grids_and_layouts.desktop: High Density Grid (Mode B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 for Dashboard. Compact spacing for Admin Settings.
grids_and_layouts.container_padding: p-4 or p-6 on mobile to prevent text collision and provide generous breathing room. Use max-h-[80vh] md:max-h-none for images.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Left-align forms, inputs, and tabular data. Center-align empty states or large visual calls-to-action (like Signature pad placeholder).

components.name: Order Receival Form
components.instructions: Single-column stacked layout on mobile. High-contrast labels. Use Shadcn forms. Large touch targets for 'Dispute Yes/No' (Radio Group or segmented control). For PIN, use a custom numeric keypad or large standard password input.

components.name: Camera Multi-Photo Capture
components.instructions: Fullscreen overlay or modal when active. Bottom control bar with a massive, distinct capture button (Klein Blue). Thumbnail gallery below or next to the camera feed showing taken photos.

components.name: Signature Pad
components.instructions: A large canvas container with a solid 1px border. Includes 'Clear' (ghost button) and 'Save' (primary) buttons immediately below it.

components.name: Receival List & Toggles
components.instructions: List of dense, rectangular items. Each row must display the supplier dropdown clearly. Inline toggles (Recorded/Invoice/Price) must use clear visual states (e.g., greyed out vs solid Klein Blue).

components.name: Admin Dashboard
components.instructions: Bento Grid Protocol: High Density. Use Shadcn Tables for staff PINs, suppliers, and archive tool.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Crisp transitions. hover:bg-slate-100 on list items. Interactive elements must change state clearly. No muddy transitions.
motion_and_interactions.focus_states: High-contrast focus rings: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-black focus:ring-offset-2. Critical for accessibility.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Subtle scale down (active:scale-95) for buttons to simulate tactile feedback on mobile.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG AA adherence. Black text on white, White text on Black/Blue. Never use low-contrast grey placeholders.
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive elements MUST have descriptive data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='capture-photo-btn', data-testid='dispute-yes-radio').

login_background.description: A yellow forklift in a large warehouse - ideal for login screen background to establish industrial context.

empty_state_pallets.description: Stacked pallets - useful for an empty state in the Dashboard or Receival List.

instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST use Shadcn components for forms, dropdowns, inputs, buttons.
All components must be .js files, NOT .tsx files. Follow standard Javascript React configurations.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, inputs, toggles, and form submissions.
Ensure the camera uses standard HTML5 WebRTC (`navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia`) configured to `facingMode: { exact: 'environment' }` for mobile rear camera.
Use 'react-signature-canvas' or similar for the signature pad component.
For the PDF / Printable delivery note, use standard CSS print media queries (`@media print`) or 'react-to-print' to strip UI elements.
Implement the mobile UI first, treating Desktop purely as the Manager/Admin dashboard view.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use the defined typography (Outfit + IBM Plex Sans).
DO NOT use dark colors as gradients. Stick to flat, solid backgrounds with 1px borders.
NEVER center align the entire app container.
Always apply transitions on specific interactive elements (e.g., transform, opacity), NEVER `transition: all`.
DO NOT use emojis for icons. Use the specified Phosphor Icons or Lucide-react.
All modals, dropdowns, and sticky headers MUST have an opaque background. DO NOT use transparent backgrounds over content.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Provide explicit error messages on forms, high contrast placeholders, and loading states for image processing/uploads.
